title: for case let x? — Iterate Non-nil Values
hints: The pattern `x?` matches only non-nil values.
Use `for case let x? in values`; count nils with `if case .none = v`.
`for case let x? in values where x > 10 { big += x }`.
jsBridge: `for case let x? in values` iterates only the non-nil values: pattern matching in a loop. JS would use `.filter(x => x != null)`. Swift can pattern-match in `for`, `if`, `guard` and `while`.
